Temper

text.markup:
When this defends, you may **charge** your hero's soul. _(Put a card from your hand face-up under your hero card.)_
The first time you would be dealt damage each turn, if you've **charged** this turn, prevent 1 of that damage.
**Temper** _(When the combat chain closes, if this defended, put a -1{d} counter on it, then if it has 0{d}, destroy it.)_
